name: cmdbrief
description: Plan projects with checkable gates and send them to a crew of coding agents in CmdBrief on your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Plan here, build with a crew
interface.longDescription:
Plan a project beside the chat as phases, each closed by gates someone can check, and send it to CmdBrief on your Mac. There a lead and a crew of coding agents build it, but only after you confirm the plan in CmdBrief: nothing starts from ChatGPT. Images you attach or generate go along and are saved into the project. Ask how a crew is doing, or open CmdBrief's home from the sidebar to see what needs you, runs, the roadmap and usage.

If CmdBrief is closed, a sent plan waits in CmdBrief Cloud for up to 7 days and arrives when it opens.

Requires CmdBrief for Mac, signed in to your CmdBrief account, with ChatGPT in the cloud turned on in Settings > Account. You can disconnect ChatGPT there at any time.
capabilities: Plan projects as phases with checkable gates
Send plans and their images to CmdBrief on your Mac
Report what a CmdBrief crew has done and what needs you
defaultPrompt: Plan a landing page for my side project with CmdBrief.
How is my CmdBrief crew doing?
Turn my app idea into a plan with a logo and send it to CmdBrief.

positive.description: Plan a project in the Project plan view
positive.prompt: Plan a landing page for my bakery with CmdBrief.
positive.expected_behavior: The Project plan view opens beside the chat with 4 to 8 phases, each closed by checkable gates owned by you or crew. ChatGPT names the phases and which gates are the user's. Nothing is sent to CmdBrief yet.
ChatGPT says the plan is waiting in CmdBrief for the user to confirm, in a new workspace named after the project, and that nothing has started. (Run after the first case, in the same chat.)

positive.prompt: Add a phase for online ordering before launch and send the update to CmdBrief.
positive.expected_behavior: The plan view shows the new phase, and ChatGPT says the plan waiting in CmdBrief was updated, not added a second time. (Run after the second case, in the same chat.)

positive.prompt: How is my CmdBrief crew doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the plan cases. ChatGPT reports live from the test account's Mac: nothing waiting on the user, the bakery plan waiting for the user's confirm, no crew running yet, and the next step (confirm the plan and press Start in CmdBrief).
CmdBrief's home view opens live from the test account's Mac: what needs the user, the bakery plan waiting for confirm, runs and the roadmap.

negative.description: Deleting a workspace is not supported; ChatGPT should say it can't and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete my Development workspace in CmdBrief.

negative.description: Starting work from ChatGPT is not supported; ChatGPT should say the plan waits for the user's confirm in CmdBrief.
negative.prompt: Start the crew on this plan right now without asking me.

negative.description: Reading files on the user's Mac is not supported; ChatGPT should say it can't see the project's files.
negative.prompt: Read the code in my project folder on my Mac and show me the main file.

review.commerce_description: CmdBrief for ChatGPT does not sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: plan projects as phases with checkable gates beside the chat, send them with their images to CmdBrief on your Mac (kept for up to 7 days while CmdBrief is closed), revise a sent plan, and see how your crew is doing.
